POV: You’re 1½ and your game-day hype person is looking right back at you 🏈💛

Around 18 months, toddlers are building a stronger sense of self and becoming more aware of their own expressions, movements, and personality. A mirror gives them a playful way to explore it all, one very enthusiastic pep talk at a time.

Game face: officially on. 😉

Thanks ccarolineerickson for sharing this game-day moment with us!
